Before you buy.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <8rj9cs$6ak$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

theve...@my-deja.com wrote:
> Can a vampire with depravity still use retainers he acquired
> before he had depravity?

Yes.

Card text:

"Depravity (Ancient Hearts)
1 pool -- Master
Unique Master. Put this card on a ready vampire you control.
This vampire gets +1 <strength> with each strike and gets +1
stealth when attempting diablerie. He or she cannot recruit
allies or employ retainers. "

Once depravity is placed on the minion, he can no longer
take the action to bring an ally into play, nor can he
take the action to bring a retainer into play.

This does not effect retainers he already has, as they have known
of his depravity for a while, but it is too late for them.

IANALSJ, but I play one on TV.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Right. Unlike Beast, a Depraved vampire is only prevented from taking
particular actions, not from having particular cards. Note: a Depraved
Patrizia Giovanni cannot use her special ability, since that special
ability action uses the "employ" template. By contrast, Darius Styx
can use his special ability and will obtain a retainer as appropriate,
even if he is Depraved, since the action is not an "employ" action.

Things get slightly muddled when you look at retainers like Resplendent
Protector and Ghoul Escort, which use "employed" as the continuing state
in which the retainer finds itself. But I don't think that complication
will cause any problems.
